claims.statement: The intrinsic fixed-n=6 section selects a descending activated rank-four entry for every synchronizing rooted binary defect.
claims.boundary: No all-n Entry-section theorem is claimed.

claims.statement: The indexed section graph has 1700 Type-I-admitting and four Type-II-only instances.
claims.boundary: Counts are indexed by rooted actions; they are not asserted to be counts of distinct unindexed mass endpoints.

claims.statement: All 15120 selected inherited contexts admit a local completion.
claims.boundary: The source-rank-five selector uses one-drop blocks; Type-I and Type-II labels refer to the post-selection rank-four completion relation. The pilot is not a full rank-five census or an all-rank return theorem.

claims.statement: The declared extremal carrier satisfies the Low-Transport conclusion through the five-cell elimination and its positive constructors.
claims.boundary: The theorem is fixed at ambient n=7.

claims.statement: On the declared five-cell surface, return admission equals endpoint normalization intersected with accounting.
claims.boundary: No general-rank or all-n admission theorem is claimed.

claims.statement: The fixed-scope interface is bounded, future-free, relation-valued, and descent-certified.
claims.boundary: The design objective is to reduce retained proof state without re-encoding the full context; no mathematical minimality claim is made.

claims.statement: Compress proof-relevant information only through quotients on which the required observable is proved to descend.
claims.boundary: The fixed-scope coarse/fine comparison does not prove a universal order on representations.
